Thread titles now align to the left in both expanded and folded rows. Short and long titles share the same starting position, with the disclosure arrow beside them.

Validated in desktop Obsidian using the four-thread demo, with all thirty-three automated tests passing.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and verifies all three files before publication.
